_note: Candidate registry for Arkansas 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Arkansas Secretary of State, Candidate Information, Search Candidate Filings (2026 cycle), retrieved 2026-10-16, cross-checked against the Secretary of State official results site setup for the 2026 General Election and Judicial Runoff (November 3, 2026) and the official 2026 Preferential Primary results, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Arkansas Secretary of State, Candidate Information, Search Candidate Filings (2026 cycle), retrieved 2026-10-16, cross-checked against the Secretary of State official results site setup for the 2026 General Election and Judicial Runoff (November 3, 2026) and the official 2026 Preferential Primary results (https://candidates.arkansas.gov/); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
